questions.question: ರಾಜು ಜನವರಿಯಿಂದ ಜೂನ್‌ವರೆಗಿನ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ₹8,400. ಅವನು ಜನವರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ₹2,400 ಮತ್ತು ಜುಲೈನಲ್ಲಿ ₹3,000 ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿಯಿಂದ ಜುಲೈವರೆಗಿನ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಎಷ್ಟು?

notes.title: ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಗಣಿತ – ಸೂತ್ರಗಳ ಸಾರಾಂಶ (KRIES ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ 1, ವಿಭಾಗ H)
notes.md:
## 1. ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು
- HCF × LCM = ಎರಡು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ
- ಭಾಜ್ಯತೆ: 3/9 – ಅಂಕಿಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ; 4 – ಕೊನೆಯ 2 ಅಂಕಿ; 8 – ಕೊನೆಯ 3 ಅಂಕಿ; 11 – ಬೆಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ 0 ಅಥವಾ 11ರ ಗುಣಕ
- n ಅಂಕಿಯ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ k ಯಿಂದ ಭಾಗ: 999…9 − ಶೇಷ
- ಮೊದಲ n ಸ್ವಾಭಾವಿಕ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ n(n+1)/2; ಸರಾಸರಿ (n+1)/2

## 2. ಶೇಕಡಾ ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಪಾತ
- x% ಏರಿಕೆ ನಂತರ y% ಇಳಿಕೆ → ನಿವ್ವಳ x − y − xy/100
- ಬೆಲೆ r% ಏರಿದರೆ ಬಳಕೆ ಕಡಿತ = r/(100+r) × 100 (25% → 20%)
- ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ
- A:B, B:C ಸೇರಿಸುವಾಗ B ಯನ್ನು ಸಮಗೊಳಿಸಿ

## 3. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಯಸ್ಸು
- ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ; ಮೊತ್ತದ ಮೂಲಕ ಯೋಚಿಸಿ
- ಸಮಾನ ದೂರಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗ = 2xy/(x+y)
- ವಯಸ್ಸು: 'n ವರ್ಷ ನಂತರ' – ಎಲ್ಲರ ವಯಸ್ಸಿಗೂ n ಸೇರಿಸಿ

## 4. ಲಾಭ–ನಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ
- ಲಾಭ% = ಲಾಭ/ಕ್ರಯ × 100 (ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಕ್ರಯಬೆಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ)
- ವಿಕ್ರಯ = ಕ್ರಯ × (100 ± ಲಾಭ/ನಷ್ಟ%)/100
- ಸತತ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ x, y → x + y − xy/100 (20 + 10 → 28%)
- ಕಳ್ಳ ತೂಕ: ಲಾಭ% = ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ/ನಿಜ ತೂಕ × 100 (900 ಗ್ರಾಂ → 11 1/9%)

## 5. ಬಡ್ಡಿ
- ಸರಳಬಡ್ಡಿ SI = PTR/100; ದ್ವಿಗುಣ ಸಮಯ = 100/R ವರ್ಷ
- ಚಕ್ರಬಡ್ಡಿ ಮೊತ್ತ A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ
- 2 ವರ್ಷದ CI − SI = P(R/100)²; 3 ವರ್ಷ = P(R/100)²(3 + R/100)
- ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ: 1.1² = 1.21, 1.1³ = 1.331, 1.05² = 1.1025
- ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆ: ಲಾಭದ ಪಾಲು ∝ ಬಂಡವಾಳ × ಸಮಯ

## 6. ಕೆಲಸ–ಸಮಯ, ವೇಗ
- ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಸೇರಿ = ab/(a+b) ದಿನ; M₁D₁ = M₂D₂
- ನಳ–ತೊಟ್ಟಿ: ತುಂಬುವುದು (+), ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು (−)
- ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ × 5/18 = ಮೀ/ಸೆ; ಮೀ/ಸೆ × 18/5 = ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ
- ರೈಲು: ಕಂಬ ದಾಟಲು ದೂರ = ರೈಲಿನ ಉದ್ದ; ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್ = ರೈಲು + ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್
- ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು – ವೇಗಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕು – ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ
- ದೋಣಿ: ನಿಶ್ಚಲ ನೀರು = (ಕೆಳಗೆ + ಮೇಲೆ)/2; ಹರಿವು = (ಕೆಳಗೆ − ಮೇಲೆ)/2

## 7. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಣಿತ
| ಆಕೃತಿ | ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ / ಘನಫಲ |
|---|---|
| ಆಯತ | l × b; ಸುತ್ತಳತೆ 2(l + b) |
| ಚೌಕ | a²; ಕರ್ಣ² / 2 |
| ತ್ರಿಭುಜ | ½ × ಪಾದ × ಎತ್ತರ |
| ವೃತ್ತ | πr²; ಪರಿಧಿ 2πr |
| ಘನ | a³; ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ 6a² |
| ಸಿಲಿಂಡರ್ | πr²h |
| ಶಂಕು | ⅓πr²h |
| ಗೋಳ | 4/3 πr³ |
- 1 ಮೀ³ = 1,000 ಲೀ; 1 ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್ = 10,000 ಮೀ²

## ⚠ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ
- ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತಳತೆ/ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ, SI/CI ಗೊಂದಲ ಉತ್ತರಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ – ಘಟಕ (ಮೀ, ಮೀ², ಮೀ³) ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ

notes.md:
## 1. ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು
- HCF × LCM = ಎರಡು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ
- ಭಾಜ್ಯತೆ: 3/9 – ಅಂಕಿಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ; 4 – ಕೊನೆಯ 2 ಅಂಕಿ; 8 – ಕೊನೆಯ 3 ಅಂಕಿ; 11 – ಬೆಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ 0 ಅಥವಾ 11ರ ಗುಣಕ
- n ಅಂಕಿಯ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ k ಯಿಂದ ಭಾಗ: 999…9 − ಶೇಷ
- ಮೊದಲ n ಸ್ವಾಭಾವಿಕ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ n(n+1)/2; ಸರಾಸರಿ (n+1)/2

## 2. ಶೇಕಡಾ ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಪಾತ
- x% ಏರಿಕೆ ನಂತರ y% ಇಳಿಕೆ → ನಿವ್ವಳ x − y − xy/100
- ಬೆಲೆ r% ಏರಿದರೆ ಬಳಕೆ ಕಡಿತ = r/(100+r) × 100 (25% → 20%)
- ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ
- A:B, B:C ಸೇರಿಸುವಾಗ B ಯನ್ನು ಸಮಗೊಳಿಸಿ

## 3. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಯಸ್ಸು
- ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ; ಮೊತ್ತದ ಮೂಲಕ ಯೋಚಿಸಿ
- ಸಮಾನ ದೂರಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗ = 2xy/(x+y)
- ವಯಸ್ಸು: 'n ವರ್ಷ ನಂತರ' – ಎಲ್ಲರ ವಯಸ್ಸಿಗೂ n ಸೇರಿಸಿ

## 4. ಲಾಭ–ನಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ
- ಲಾಭ% = ಲಾಭ/ಕ್ರಯ × 100 (ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಕ್ರಯಬೆಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ)
- ವಿಕ್ರಯ = ಕ್ರಯ × (100 ± ಲಾಭ/ನಷ್ಟ%)/100
- ಸತತ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ x, y → x + y − xy/100 (20 + 10 → 28%)
- ಕಳ್ಳ ತೂಕ: ಲಾಭ% = ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ/ನಿಜ ತೂಕ × 100 (900 ಗ್ರಾಂ → 11 1/9%)

## 5. ಬಡ್ಡಿ
- ಸರಳಬಡ್ಡಿ SI = PTR/100; ದ್ವಿಗುಣ ಸಮಯ = 100/R ವರ್ಷ
- ಚಕ್ರಬಡ್ಡಿ ಮೊತ್ತ A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ
- 2 ವರ್ಷದ CI − SI = P(R/100)²; 3 ವರ್ಷ = P(R/100)²(3 + R/100)
- ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ: 1.1² = 1.21, 1.1³ = 1.331, 1.05² = 1.1025
- ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆ: ಲಾಭದ ಪಾಲು ∝ ಬಂಡವಾಳ × ಸಮಯ

## 6. ಕೆಲಸ–ಸಮಯ, ವೇಗ
- ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಸೇರಿ = ab/(a+b) ದಿನ; M₁D₁ = M₂D₂
- ನಳ–ತೊಟ್ಟಿ: ತುಂಬುವುದು (+), ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು (−)
- ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ × 5/18 = ಮೀ/ಸೆ; ಮೀ/ಸೆ × 18/5 = ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ
- ರೈಲು: ಕಂಬ ದಾಟಲು ದೂರ = ರೈಲಿನ ಉದ್ದ; ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್ = ರೈಲು + ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್
- ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು – ವೇಗಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕು – ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ
- ದೋಣಿ: ನಿಶ್ಚಲ ನೀರು = (ಕೆಳಗೆ + ಮೇಲೆ)/2; ಹರಿವು = (ಕೆಳಗೆ − ಮೇಲೆ)/2

## 7. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಣಿತ
| ಆಕೃತಿ | ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ / ಘನಫಲ |
|---|---|
| ಆಯತ | l × b; ಸುತ್ತಳತೆ 2(l + b) |
| ಚೌಕ | a²; ಕರ್ಣ² / 2 |
| ತ್ರಿಭುಜ | ½ × ಪಾದ × ಎತ್ತರ |
| ವೃತ್ತ | πr²; ಪರಿಧಿ 2πr |
| ಘನ | a³; ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ 6a² |
| ಸಿಲಿಂಡರ್ | πr²h |
| ಶಂಕು | ⅓πr²h |
| ಗೋಳ | 4/3 πr³ |
- 1 ಮೀ³ = 1,000 ಲೀ; 1 ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್ = 10,000 ಮೀ²

## ⚠ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ
- ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತಳತೆ/ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ, SI/CI ಗೊಂದಲ ಉತ್ತರಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ – ಘಟಕ (ಮೀ, ಮೀ², ಮೀ³) ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ

notes.md:
## 1. ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು
- HCF × LCM = ಎರಡು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ
- ಭಾಜ್ಯತೆ: 3/9 – ಅಂಕಿಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ; 4 – ಕೊನೆಯ 2 ಅಂಕಿ; 8 – ಕೊನೆಯ 3 ಅಂಕಿ; 11 – ಬೆಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ 0 ಅಥವಾ 11ರ ಗುಣಕ
- n ಅಂಕಿಯ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ k ಯಿಂದ ಭಾಗ: 999…9 − ಶೇಷ
- ಮೊದಲ n ಸ್ವಾಭಾವಿಕ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ n(n+1)/2; ಸರಾಸರಿ (n+1)/2

## 2. ಶೇಕಡಾ ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಪಾತ
- x% ಏರಿಕೆ ನಂತರ y% ಇಳಿಕೆ → ನಿವ್ವಳ x − y − xy/100
- ಬೆಲೆ r% ಏರಿದರೆ ಬಳಕೆ ಕಡಿತ = r/(100+r) × 100 (25% → 20%)
- ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ
- A:B, B:C ಸೇರಿಸುವಾಗ B ಯನ್ನು ಸಮಗೊಳಿಸಿ

## 3. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಯಸ್ಸು
- ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ; ಮೊತ್ತದ ಮೂಲಕ ಯೋಚಿಸಿ
- ಸಮಾನ ದೂರಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ವೇಗ = 2xy/(x+y)
- ವಯಸ್ಸು: 'n ವರ್ಷ ನಂತರ' – ಎಲ್ಲರ ವಯಸ್ಸಿಗೂ n ಸೇರಿಸಿ

## 4. ಲಾಭ–ನಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ
- ಲಾಭ% = ಲಾಭ/ಕ್ರಯ × 100 (ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಕ್ರಯಬೆಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ)
- ವಿಕ್ರಯ = ಕ್ರಯ × (100 ± ಲಾಭ/ನಷ್ಟ%)/100
- ಸತತ ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿ x, y → x + y − xy/100 (20 + 10 → 28%)
- ಕಳ್ಳ ತೂಕ: ಲಾಭ% = ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ/ನಿಜ ತೂಕ × 100 (900 ಗ್ರಾಂ → 11 1/9%)

## 5. ಬಡ್ಡಿ
- ಸರಳಬಡ್ಡಿ SI = PTR/100; ದ್ವಿಗುಣ ಸಮಯ = 100/R ವರ್ಷ
- ಚಕ್ರಬಡ್ಡಿ ಮೊತ್ತ A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ
- 2 ವರ್ಷದ CI − SI = P(R/100)²; 3 ವರ್ಷ = P(R/100)²(3 + R/100)
- ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ: 1.1² = 1.21, 1.1³ = 1.331, 1.05² = 1.1025
- ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆ: ಲಾಭದ ಪಾಲು ∝ ಬಂಡವಾಳ × ಸಮಯ

## 6. ಕೆಲಸ–ಸಮಯ, ವೇಗ
- ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಸೇರಿ = ab/(a+b) ದಿನ; M₁D₁ = M₂D₂
- ನಳ–ತೊಟ್ಟಿ: ತುಂಬುವುದು (+), ಖಾಲಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು (−)
- ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ × 5/18 = ಮೀ/ಸೆ; ಮೀ/ಸೆ × 18/5 = ಕಿ.ಮೀ/ಗಂ
- ರೈಲು: ಕಂಬ ದಾಟಲು ದೂರ = ರೈಲಿನ ಉದ್ದ; ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್ = ರೈಲು + ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್
- ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು – ವೇಗಗಳ ಮೊತ್ತ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕು – ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ
- ದೋಣಿ: ನಿಶ್ಚಲ ನೀರು = (ಕೆಳಗೆ + ಮೇಲೆ)/2; ಹರಿವು = (ಕೆಳಗೆ − ಮೇಲೆ)/2

## 7. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಣಿತ
| ಆಕೃತಿ | ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ / ಘನಫಲ |
|---|---|
| ಆಯತ | l × b; ಸುತ್ತಳತೆ 2(l + b) |
| ಚೌಕ | a²; ಕರ್ಣ² / 2 |
| ತ್ರಿಭುಜ | ½ × ಪಾದ × ಎತ್ತರ |
| ವೃತ್ತ | πr²; ಪರಿಧಿ 2πr |
| ಘನ | a³; ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ 6a² |
| ಸಿಲಿಂಡರ್ | πr²h |
| ಶಂಕು | ⅓πr²h |
| ಗೋಳ | 4/3 πr³ |
- 1 ಮೀ³ = 1,000 ಲೀ; 1 ಹೆಕ್ಟೇರ್ = 10,000 ಮೀ²

## ⚠ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ
- ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತಳತೆ/ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ, SI/CI ಗೊಂದಲ ಉತ್ತರಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ – ಘಟಕ (ಮೀ, ಮೀ², ಮೀ³) ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ

questions.explanation: x(1/24 + 1/60) = 1 − 10/24 gives x = 10. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)

questions.question: A boy was asked to multiply a given number by 8/17, instead, he divided it by 8/17 and got the result 225 more than what he should have got if he had multiplied the number by 8/17. Then the given number was
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: n(17/8 − 8/17) = 225n/136 = 225. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)

questions.question: What will be the speed of the water if a boat going at 9 km/hr in still water and 12 km/hr in downstream and comes back in total three hours?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 12 − 9. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)

questions.question: Geetha cuts a cake into two halves and cut one half into smaller pieces of equal size. Each of the small pieces is 25 grams in weight. If she has eleven pieces of the cake in total with her, what was the weight of the original cake?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 10 pieces × 25 g = one half. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)

questions.question: A Shopkeeper earns a profit of 25 percent on selling a radio at 15 percent discount on the printed price. The ratio of printed price and cost price of the radio is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 0.85P = 1.25C. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)

questions.question: If digit '1' is used 136 times while writing all the page numbers of a book, then what will be the total number of pages in the book?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: Up to 99: 20 ones; 100–195 adds 116. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)

questions.question: Three friends A, B and C start running around a circular stadium and complete a single round in 24 seconds, 36 seconds and 30 seconds respectively. After how many minutes will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: LCM = 360 s. (Official answer: KEA final key, Legislative Council Secretariat exam 2024.)

questions.question: A spider climbs 10 meters of a pole in 20 minutes and slips down 2 meters at the very moment. If it takes 3 hours to climb on its top, then the length of the pole is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: Nine climbs: 8 × 8 = 64, then the last 10 m (no slip). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: A person lends 40% of his sum of money at 15% per annum, 50% of rest at 10% per annum and the rest at 18% per annum rate of interest. What would be the annual rate of interest, if the interest is calculated on the whole sum?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 6 + 3 + 5.4. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: If x and y are positive integers such that (3x + 7y) is a multiple of 11, then which of the following is also a multiple of 11?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 9(3x + 7y) ≡ 5x − 3y (mod 11). (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of the word READING be arranged in such a way that the vowels always come together?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 5! × 3!. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: At a special sale, 10 tickets can be purchased for the price of 3 tickets. If 10 tickets are purchased at the sale, the amount saved will be what percent of the original price of the 10 tickets?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 7 of 10 saved. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: The compound interest on Rs. 2000 in 2 years, if the rate of interest is 4% per annum for the first year and 3% per annum for the second year, will be
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 2000 × 1.04 × 1.03 − 2000. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: A and B invest in a business in the ratio of 3:2. If 5% of the total profit goes to charity and A's share is ₹855, then the total profit is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 0.95 × 3/5 × P = 855. (Official answer: KEA final key, GTTC 2024.)

questions.question: Speed of Deepak and Vinod are in the ratio of 19:12 respectively. If speed of Vinod is 84 km/hr, then what will be the speed of Deepak?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 84 ÷ 12 = 7; 19 × 7 = 133. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A bag has Rs. 785 in the denomination of Rs. 2, Rs. 5 and Rs. 10 coins. The coins are in the ratio of 6:9:10. How many coins of Rs. 5 are in the bag?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 12x + 45x + 100x = 157x = 785 → x = 5; Rs. 5 coins = 45. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A person purchases a notebook from a supplier at Rs. 12 each for 30 notebooks. He sells those notebooks at Rs. 15 each for 20 notebooks and remaining notebooks for Rs. 37.50 each. Find his profit percent.
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: Cost 360; sale 300 + 375 = 675; profit 315 = 87.5%. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: The average expenditure of Raju for January to June is Rs. 8400 and he spends Rs. 2400 in January and Rs. 3000 in July. What is his average expenditure for the months of February to July?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 1
questions.explanation: 50,400 − 2,400 + 3,000 = 51,000; ÷ 6 = 8,500. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A stadium with 4 exits can evacuate 100 people every 2 minutes through each exit. If a fire alert is raised when there are 6500 people and crowd panic sets in, after 32 minutes how many people are at the risk of stampede?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 per minute; 32 minutes → 6400 out; 100 remain. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Two pipes P and Q can fill a tank in 20 minutes and 25 minutes respectively. Both the pipes are opened together, but after 5 minutes, pipe Q is turned off. What is the total time required to fill the tank?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 5 × (1/20 + 1/25) = 0.45; the remaining 0.55 takes P 11 minutes; total 16. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Find the value of √(12 + √(12 + √(12 + ....
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: x = √(12 + x) → x² − x − 12 = 0 → x = 4 (the root is positive). (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A washing machine is available at Rs. 6,400 cash or for Rs. 1,400 cash down payment and five monthly instalments of Rs. 1,030 each. What is the rate of interest charged under instalment plan?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2

questions.question: In throwing of two fair dice, what is the probability that the first digit of the pair of outcomes is smaller than the second digit?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 36 outcomes; 6 ties; half of the other 30 = 15. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Find the greatest number of 4 digits, which is exactly divisible by 26.
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 9999 = 26 × 384 + 15; 9999 − 15 = 9984. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
The pie chart given below shows the percentage distribution of production of bags by 5 different companies, which the table shows the data of ratio of duffel bags to backpacks, produced by these 5 companies. Study the chart carefully and answer the question. Total bags produced = 1000.
[Pie chart: A 20%, B 5%, C 15%, D 35%, E 25%. Table – Duffel bags : Backpacks: A 1:1, B 3:2, C 8:7, D 12:13, E 13:17]
How many bags (Duffel) were produced by company D and E together?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: D: 350 × 12/25 = 168; E: 250 × 13/30 ≈ 108.3; total ≈ 276. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question:
The values of (X, Y, Z) in the table respectively are
[Table: row 1 – 16, X, total Y; row 2 – 20, 36, total 58; column totals – 36, Z, grand total 88]
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: Y = 88 − 58 = 30; X = 30 − 16 = 14; Z = 14 + 36 = 50. (As printed, row 2 adds to 56, not 58; code (1) is the intended answer.) (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Weekly incomes of A and B are in the ratio 7:3 and their weekly expenses are in the ratio 5:2 respectively. The difference of their savings is ₹200. Weekly income of A is ₹5,600. Weekly expense of B is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: B's income 2,400. (5600 − 5x) − (2400 − 2x) = 200 → x = 1000; B's expense 2x = 2,000. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 15 km/hr. It can go 30 km upstream and return downstream to the original point in 4 hours 30 minutes. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 30/(15 − s) + 30/(15 + s) = 4.5 → 225 − s² = 200 → s = 5. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: When the rate of interest in a bank is reduced from 5% to 4%, a man deposits Rs. 2000 more and his annual income remains the same. The original deposit is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 0.05x = 0.04(x + 2000) → x = 8000. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A small cat can catch 12 rats in 6 minutes and a big cat can catch 6 rats in 12 minutes. If there are sufficient rats, how many rats can both the cats catch together in 20 minutes?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 2 + 0.5 = 2.5 rats per minute × 20. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: The perimeter of two squares are 20 cm and 48 cm. The perimeter of a third square whose area is the sum of the area of the two squares is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: Sides 5 and 12 → 25 + 144 = 169 → side 13. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 4107. If the H.C.F of these numbers is 37, then the greatest number is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 4107 = 37 × 111 = 37² × 3. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A man bought some oranges at Rs. 30 per dozen and bought the same number of oranges at Rs. 25 per dozen. He sold these oranges at Rs. 32 per dozen and gained Rs. 270. The total number of oranges bought by him was:
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: Average cost 27.5, profit 4.5 per dozen; 270 / 4.5. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: If the angles of a triangle are in the ratio 3 : 2 : 7, then the angles are:
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 180 / 12 = 15. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A fitness app shows that a user walked, on average of 10,000 steps per day over a week. If on the last 3 days, the step counts were 9000, 12,000 and 10,400 respectively, what is the average number of steps for the first 4 days of the week?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: (70000 − 31400) / 4. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A paint company mixes red, blue and green paints in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 to make a wall coating. If 60 litres of the mixture is prepared, how much red and blue paint is used together?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 3/6 of 60. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: The least number which when divided by 5, 7 and 9 leaves a remainder 3, but when divided by 6 leaves no remainder is:
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 315k + 3 divisible by 6 → k = 1. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A school receives 600 books for its Book Bank to be distributed to Mathematics, English and Social studies sections in the ratio 3:2:1. Later 10% of Mathematics and 25% of English books were found damaged. If the undamaged total was 460, how many social studies books were in good condition?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: Maths 300 − 30, English 200 − 50 → 420; 460 − 420. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: The average weight of 6 patients in a hospital ward is 72 kg. A new patient is admitted and now the average weight becomes 68 kg. Find the weight of the new patient in kg.
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 7 × 68 − 6 × 72. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Chaitra saves Rs. 2 per day in her piggy bank. After 100 days she puts her total savings amount in a bank at 4% simple interest annually. How much interest does she earn in 2 years?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 200 × 4 × 2 / 100. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Ratio of curved surface area to total surface area of a cylinder is 11 : 18. Also area of its circular end is 616 cm². Then the volume of the cylinder is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: h : (r + h) = 11 : 18 → r = 14, h = 22; V = 616 × 22. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: There are some cows and ducks. The total number of legs is equal to 14 more than twice the number of heads. The number of cows is
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: Each cow adds 2 extra legs: 14 / 2. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: At a music concert, 30% of audience were women. Of the rest, 60% were men and the rest were children. If there were 1400 children, then what is the total number of audience?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: Children = 40% of 70% = 28%. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: Digit 1 is occurring 136 times on writing all of the page numbers of a book. What will be the total number of pages in the book? (Book's page number starts from 1)
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 1–99 use 20 ones; 100–195 use 116. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: A shopkeeper sells an article at Rs 96 and gets x% of profit. However, when he sells it at Rs 68 he loses (x − 5)% of cost price. What is the original cost of the article?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: 96 + 68 = C(2 + 0.05) → C = 80. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)

questions.question: P, Q and R can complete a job in 8 days. If Q does half what P and R together do in 1 day, then in how many days can Q alone do the half work?
questions.subject: Previous-Year Questions – KEA GK papers 2
questions.explanation: Q = 1/3 of the total rate = 1/24 per day; half the work takes 12 days. (Answer worked out by ExamSim; not KEA's official key.)
